claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Amiloride at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent; its known pharmacology (epithelial sodium channel blockade, Na+/H+ exchange inhibition, macropinocytosis inhibition) does not produce a characteristic cell-killing pattern in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
